card.name: The word injection after drug name for
card.fires_on: The word "injection" right after a drug name plus "for" (as in "caspofungin acetate for injection"). It also fires on a few word-ending pieces of long names or links.

modes.label: Drug name "for injection"
modes.description: The word injection follows a drug name and "for" when the drug is named again in the label text.

modes.label: Ends of names and codes
modes.description: The last piece of a long drug name, proper name or link code.
